prompts: Which comments on my recent LinkedIn posts deserve a reply?
Turn these notes into a LinkedIn post draft in my usual tone.
How did my LinkedIn posts perform over the last 30 days?
requirements: A Taplio account with an active plan and a connected LinkedIn profile.
limitations: This connection acts on the LinkedIn profile linked to the Taplio account only.
Publishing, liking, commenting, and connection requests go through Taplio and follow its daily LinkedIn limits.
This app does not start automatic monitoring from its MCP connection alone.
